paper_identity.title: Comprehensive analysis of the scissors mode in heavy even-even nuclei

cross_mass_significance: Establishes the universal saturation of scissors mode B(M1) strength across well-deformed rare-earth and actinide nuclei (B(M1) ~ 3.0 - 3.4 mu_N^2), refuting the naive unconstrained macroscopic two-rotor model prediction B(M1) proportional to beta2^2 and demonstrating that pairing reduction and valence shell truncation enforce a strict quantum collectivity ceiling.
